params.message:
Werf fiche: his usual day as a one-tap answer, and a way to set it

Departure, return and break were asked fresh every day, also for a man who
leaves at 06:45 and takes half an hour every day.

- A new UsualDay works out his usual departure, return and break: what he set
  himself, and otherwise what most of his last twenty fiches say, once at
  least three of them agree.
- The question panel offers it as one tap: "06:45 zoals gewoonlijk" on the
  departure and return questions, the usual break marked "gewoonlijk", and a
  part's hours start from it when the sheet has nothing better. It is never
  written on a fiche by itself: hours go to the customer, and a habit is a
  guess until he taps it.
- "Mijn gewone dag" in the werf menu lets him set the three himself; an empty
  field goes back to his own fiches.

Needs php artisan migrate (workers.usual_start, usual_end, usual_break).
